$description: GENERATED by kit/scripts/make_single_file_tokens.mjs from kit/tokens/*.json — do not edit. Colour tiers are top-level; every other token file is keyed by its stem. Regenerate: node kit/scripts/make_single_file_tokens.mjs. Verified on every /gate: --check.

primitive.$description: Raw color palette — never reference directly in components

semantic.$description: Purpose-based tokens — use these in designs and layouts

danger.$description: Same token as destructive (alias — this name is consumed across the kit examples/components)

danger-hover.$description: Same token as destructive-hover (alias — this name is consumed across the kit examples/components)

error.$description: The AA-safe error TEXT hue (alias — this bare name is consumed as normal-size text; the -icon hue fails 4.5:1 on white)

success.$description: The AA-safe success TEXT hue (alias — this bare name is consumed as normal-size text; the -icon hue fails 4.5:1 on white)

warning.$description: The AA-safe warning TEXT hue (alias — this bare name is consumed as normal-size text; the -icon hue fails 4.5:1 on white)

tertiary.$description: Placeholder text — use only as hint, not essential info

on-action.$description: Text on primary action bg — 8.6:1 on blue-600

inverse.$description: Text on an inverse surface (alias — this name is consumed across the kit examples/components)

error.$description: Error-colored text (alias — this name is consumed across the kit examples/components)

brand.$description: Light brand tint — a SURFACE, safe under brand-colored text (alias; the action.primary blue at 1:1 against link text was a hazard)

inverse.$description: Dark surface on the light theme (alias — this name is consumed across the kit examples/components)

strong.$description: Essential control boundary — 4.8:1 on page, meets WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1)

success.$description: Bare success hue, AA-safe for text (alias)

scrim.$description: Modal/drawer backdrop (alias — this name is consumed across the kit examples/components)

component.$description: Component-scoped tokens — use in component implementations

dark.$description: Dark mode semantic overrides — swap at :root[data-theme='dark']

link.$description: Lighter in dark for ≥4.5:1 on dark surfaces (blue.600 fails)

brand.$description: Dark brand surface tint — pairs with the blue.400 dark link text

strong.$description: Essential control boundary — 4.2:1 on dark page (meets 3:1)

primary.$description: blue.600 keeps white on-action ≥4.5:1 on dark (blue.500 = 3.68 fails)

primary-hover.$description: Darkens on hover so white text stays ≥4.5:1

feedback.$description: Dark overrides for the text-facing feedback aliases — the light -text hues sit at ~2.1-2.8:1 on the dark page

blur.$description: Blur radius scale for backdrop/frosted-glass effects and overlays. Use restraint — glass is a once-per-view effect (see taste/design-taste.md).

sm.$description: Subtle frost — small popovers, tags over imagery

md.$description: Default glass — cards, sticky headers over content

lg.$description: Strong frost — modal backdrops, navigation overlays

xl.$description: Heavy frost — full-screen scrims, immersive overlays

borders.$description: Border radius and width tokens. Radii follow a geometric scale; widths are kept minimal.

thick.$description: Heavy emphasis — sidebar indicator, branded borders

breakpoints.$description: Mobile-first responsive breakpoints. Write styles for mobile first, then layer on min-width queries. Container max-widths prevent content from stretching too wide on large screens.

container.$description: Max-width constraints for centered content containers

2xl.$description: Slightly narrower than breakpoint for breathing room

prose.$description: Optimal reading width for long-form text

data-viz.$description: Data-visualization color + axis tokens. Categorical palette is ordered for maximum perceptual separation and color-vision-deficiency safety (Okabe–Ito-inspired). Use these for charts — never the brand action/feedback colors directly. Charts are graphical objects: meaningful strokes meet 3:1, and series must also be distinguished by shape/label/pattern, not hue alone.

categorical.$description: Qualitative series colors. Assign in order; cap at 8 — beyond that, group or re-encode.

sequential.$description: Single-hue ramp for ordered/continuous data (low → high). 5 stops; interpolate for more.

diverging.$description: Two-hue ramp around a neutral midpoint (e.g. below/above target, negative/positive change).

semantic.$description: Outcome-coded series (gains vs. losses). Distinct from feedback tokens so charts theme independently.

label.$description: Meets 4.5:1 — axis labels are essential text

grid.$description: Non-essential gridlines — low contrast is acceptable (decorative reference).

gradients.$description: Semantic gradient presets. Use sparingly — one signature gradient per view (see taste/design-taste.md). Stops reference primitive colors; positions are 0–1.

primary.$description: Indigo → violet. Hero CTAs, brand surfaces.

primary-soft.$description: Lighter brand wash for large backgrounds

subtle.$description: Near-flat dark surface depth — barely perceptible

aurora.$description: Multi-stop accent — decorative only, never behind body text

motion.$description: Motion system — durations, easings, and composite transition presets. UI motion is 100–300ms, never exceeds 500ms. Every animation guides attention, shows connection, or provides feedback. Always paired with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

instant.$description: No animation — reduced-motion fallback, or instant state swaps

fast.$description: Micro-interactions — hover, focus, small color/opacity changes

base.$description: Default UI transition — most state changes, toggles, dropdowns

moderate.$description: Larger transitions — modals, drawers, accordions, page sections

slow.$description: Maximum allowed — full-screen transitions, large reveals. Never exceed this.

normal.$description: Alias of base — the kit docs and skills consume --duration-normal

linear.$description: Constant speed — only for continuous loops (spinners, progress)

ease-out.$description: Decelerate — for ENTRANCES. Elements arrive fast and settle. The default for most UI.

ease-in.$description: Accelerate — for EXITS. Elements leave by speeding away.

ease-in-out.$description: Accelerate then decelerate — for STATE CHANGES that move in place (toggles, reorders)

spring.$description: Overshoot — playful emphasis (success checkmarks, badges). Use sparingly.

emphasized.$description: Material 3 emphasized curve — the kit docs consume --ease-emphasized; added to make that name resolvable

transition.$description: Composite presets — duration + easing pairs ready to apply. Reference these in components.

micro.$description: Hover/focus on atoms — buttons, links, inputs

default.$description: General-purpose state change — the safe default

enter.$description: Element entering the screen — modal open, toast appear, menu reveal

exit.$description: Element leaving the screen — exits are faster than entrances

keyframes.$description: Named keyframe recipes. Property/from/to are documented for implementers; encode as CSS @keyframes or framework equivalents.

fade-in.$description: Reduced-motion-safe substitute for any directional entrance

slide-up.$description: Subtle rise on entrance — popovers, toasts. Pair with fade.

spin.$description: Loading spinner — use with duration 600–1000ms and linear easing

reducedMotion.$description: When prefers-reduced-motion is set: replace movement with opacity-only fades or instant swaps. Never remove feedback entirely — keep the state change, drop the travel.

duration.$description: Collapse all motion durations to instant, OR cap at duration.fast for opacity-only fades

strategy.$value: Disable transform/position animation; retain opacity fade ≤100ms; keep all non-motion feedback (color, text, ARIA live regions)

opacity.$description: Semantic alpha scale. Use these instead of hardcoding rgba() alpha in components.

disabled.$description: Disabled control opacity (paired with pointer-events: none)

focus.$description: Focus state-layer overlay (in addition to focus ring)

ghost.$description: Barely-there surface tint (ghost buttons, zebra rows)

shadows.$description: 5-level elevation system. Higher elevation = more prominence. Uses layered shadows for realism.

sm.$description: Subtle inset — pressed buttons, input fields

colored.$description: Brand-colored shadows for emphasis — use sparingly

focus-ring.$description: Double-ring focus indicator — 2px white + 2px blue. Visible on both light and dark backgrounds. Meets WCAG 2.4.7.

sizing.$description: Control sizing, icon sizing, and aspect ratios. Control heights drive Button/Input/Select consistency; all meet the 24px min target (44px recommended for primary touch).

control.$description: Interactive control height (Button, Input, Select, etc.)

xs.$description: Min target size (WCAG 2.5.8) — dense tables, chips

icon.$description: Icon box sizes — keep stroke weight consistent across sizes

aspectRatio.$description: Use the unitless ratio in CSS aspect-ratio / native equivalents

spacing.$description: 4px base unit spacing scale. Use semantic tokens for layout; use scale tokens for component internals.

states.$description: Semantic interaction-state tokens. Centralizes the visual treatment of the 8 component states (CLAUDE.md) so they are consistent across every component and framework.

opacity.$description: Content dim while async; pair with aria-busy + spinner
Editable-looking but locked; keep legible (not disabled)

theming.$description: Multi-brand theming + density modes. Themes override SEMANTIC tokens only (primitives stay constant, like dark mode). Density scales spacing/control sizing without touching color/type. Apply via [data-theme] / [data-density] (web) or theme objects (native).

theme.$description: Brand override maps. Each theme re-points semantic.action.* (and optionally accent). Add a theme by cloning this shape. Light/dark still handled in colors.json.

density.$description: Multiplier applied to spacing + control sizing. 1 = default. Compact for data-dense enterprise UI, spacious for marketing/touch.

typography.$description: Typography tokens using Major Third (1.25) modular scale. All sizes in px for precision; convert to rem at 1rem = 16px.

textStyle.$description: Composite text styles — use these in components
